cic_clc_orthogonality_attestation: This rubric encodes NO CIC->CLC subset binding. Per v7.0.8 F-CIC-CLC-COUPLING-VIOLATION, scoring criteria are opportunity-driven runtime, not archetype-driven design-time. The rubric is portable across all six Customer Identity Categories (Food Systems / Educator / Public Agency / Arts & Culture / Cooperative / Ecosystem Intermediary).

cross_check_with_funder_published_rubric.default: If funder_published_reporting_rubric.yaml present at vault_shared/funder_intelligence/<funder_id>/, run funder rubric FIRST + this rubric SECOND for cross-check (per OQ-REPORT-RUBRIC-DEFAULT). Otherwise run this rubric only.
cross_check_with_funder_published_rubric.discrepancy_handling: If Judge score on this rubric and Judge score on funder published rubric differ by >= 10 points, surface as council split for operator decision (Law 4 tie-breaker).

non_ownership: This rubric does NOT define proposal_commitments.yaml schema (owned by §11 v1 §11.5.2; this rubric consumes via PROMOTED-status filter).
This rubric does NOT define claim_evidence_map.yaml schema (owned by §14 v1 §14.5.1; this rubric consumes via per-claim source trace).
This rubric does NOT define operational-data sub-kind schemas (owned by §2 v7.2 §7; this rubric consumes via Data Collector write paths).
This rubric does NOT define funder rubric schemas (owned by Funder Intelligence DB v7.0.5 §1; this rubric cross-checks against funder published rubrics).

scoring_dimensions.scoring_basis: For each PROMOTED commitment row, the draft addresses the commitment_text + meets all evaluation_criteria. Numeric criteria meet target within tolerance; narrative criteria meet required_min_length_chars; required_sub_sections all present in draft.

Every claim in draft has a corresponding entry in claim_evidence_map.yaml with appropriate sources (numeric → operational_data metrics OR kfr; narrative → operational_data narrative_entries OR proposal_commitments; photo → operational_data photos; beneficiary → operational_data beneficiary_records WITH consent_tier verification). Source values + content hashes verifiable at finalize re-read.
Every claim's scope_tags is a subset of the union of PROMOTED commitments' scope_tags. No cross-grant claims. No cross-period claims absent operator-signed cross-period reuse override per §14.12.1.

All numeric claims compare exactly in Decimal (per v7.0.4-M1 mandate) against operational-data and KFR canonical values. Variance computations in Decimal. Unit consistency across the report. Period-boundary discipline (no cumulative metrics absent funder-template requirement).
Narrative tone matches funder's typical narrative tone per Funder Intel DB context (when present). Length per funder template constraints. Disclaimers per state card requirements (when applicable).

Beneficiary section respects per-beneficiary consent_tier (narrative-text-only floor for text inclusion; metrics-only allows aggregate count only; no-narrative excludes entirely). Photo gallery excludes consent_tier internal_only. No identifying-detail leakage above tier permission.

All required sub_sections per reporting_template are present. All required fields per sub_section are populated. Markdown formatting clean (no conversational fluff; no LLM self-commentary; no markdown fences around structured data per Rule 4 Clean Output).

verdict_thresholds.BLOCKING: score < 70 OR multiple fail_close_below thresholds not cleared
verdict_thresholds.READY_TO_FINALIZE: score >= 85 AND all fail_close_below thresholds cleared
verdict_thresholds.REQUIRES_REVISION: score in [70, 84] OR any fail_close_below threshold not cleared
